description: Read queue metadata and pending, claimed, completed and failed counts using the read token. Does not list payloads, disclose role tokens or extend the fixed expiry.

queue_id.description: The queue_id from create_agent_queue, or from create_agent_run for a run with delegated steps.

read_token.description: The read_token from create_agent_queue, shown once. It reads the queue and its jobs.

name: read_agent_queue
title: Read agent queue
